label: late-episode D1 after a rare a1->S2 rewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D1, almost only when the reward input is 1, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99, 96% of mass; never before trial 80). Value-head output is low at these steps (98% of mass in the bottom value bin). Within that context it is strongly selective for the previous trial having gone a1 -> S2 (rare) and been rewarded, the model-based switch-to-a2 case; the top activations are this pattern, followed by a switch to a2. Recorded predicate (all observed): precision 0.79, recall 0.42, mass recall 0.59 on dev. Remaining mass is mostly other late-episode D1 steps after a reward in S2 (often a common a2 -> S2 reward right after an unrewarded trial). These are weaker activations. Adding that clause raises mass recall to 0.79 but lowers precision to 0.47 (same F1). Does not fire at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before trial 80.
